# Trey Brunson

> Trey Brunson is a Bitcoin industry professional, focused on Bitcoin since 2016, who
> created Secret Satoshis: a Bitcoin newsletter, the Bitcoin-native AI agent Agent 21, and
> the open data and code behind them.

Trey got into Bitcoin at the University of Delaware. He leads crypto operations for
Tribe Capital’s venture capital funds. His previous roles at Blockchain.com, Grant
Thornton, Binance.US, and 21Shares span management consulting, exchange operations,
and institutional Bitcoin products. He is based in New York.

This site is a single page. Its live Bitcoin price, UTXO circulating supply, and market
cap are fetched primarily from BRK (bitview.space) with automatic failover to the public
mempool.space API (and protocol-scheduled supply fallback), matching Secret Satoshis'
other live surfaces. Check the Secret Satoshis sources below for dated research releases.

## Start here

- [Trey Brunson](https://treybrunson.com/): about Trey, his work and how to reach him.
- [Secret Satoshis](https://secretsatoshis.com/): overview of the newsletter, Agent 21, and research tools.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/trey-brunson): career history and contact.

## Platforms and projects

- [Secret Satoshis Newsletter](https://newsletter.secretsatoshis.com/): a yearly Bitcoin price outlook and weekly market analysis that tracks it, written for long-term investors.
- [Agent 21](https://agent21.secretsatoshis.com/): the Bitcoin-native AI agent built by Secret Satoshis, in invite-only beta.
- [Market Dashboard](https://dashboard.secretsatoshis.com/): daily Bitcoin market data, valuation models, on-chain conditions, and cycle context.
- [Chart Library](https://charts.secretsatoshis.com/): interactive charts covering price, ETF flows, on-chain activity, supply, mining, and valuation.
- [Open-source code](https://github.com/SecretSatoshis): the data, notebooks, charts and models behind the analysis.

## Featured articles

- [2026 Bitcoin Price Outlook](https://newsletter.secretsatoshis.com/p/bitcoin-2026-price-outlook): bear, base, and bull year-end Bitcoin price scenarios tracked in public all year.
- [Bitcoin Adoption Thesis](https://newsletter.secretsatoshis.com/p/bitcoin-ahead-of-the-curve): how Bitcoin is gaining adoption as an internet-native network and a form of global money.
- [Should I buy bitcoin?](https://newsletter.secretsatoshis.com/p/should-i-buy-bitcoin): a data-driven case study testing a long-term Bitcoin savings plan across real price history.

## Guides for agents
